payload.posture: Read Genesis 48:1–7 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states joseph brings Manasseh and Ephraim to his sick father; Jacob recalls God’s promise and claims the two sons within his own tribal household. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
